_comment: Policy versions for the hosted legal site. 'current' must match TERMS_VERSION / PRIVACY_POLICY_VERSION in lib/config/legal.ts. To publish a new version: copy the current text to archive/<doc>/v<old>.md, add an entry with source set to that file, edit app/<doc>.tsx, bump 'current' and lib/config/legal.ts, then run npm run legal:build. See docs/HANDOFF.md.
